outcome: persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)
cohort: The study included 1076 infants with PPHN (cases) and 2152 controls (infants receiving mechanical ventilation) matched for gestational age, sex, birth weight, parenteral nutrition administration, and age at NBS collection.
finding: Infants with PPHN exhibit distinct early metabolic profiles, with ornithine, tyrosine, and TSH associated with decreased odds of PPHN, and phenylalanine associated with increased odds of PPHN.
birth_weight: Birth weight was a matching characteristic between cases and controls.
gest_age: Gestational age was a matching characteristic between cases and controls.
